description: Full profile of one surf town: description, season, water temperature, wave types, levels and curated surf spots (each with its type, level, the way its coast faces in degrees (facing), its best tide where known (tide, e.g. "low to mid, rising", with tideSources), a reviewed, freely licensed photo of surf at that break from Wikimedia Commons when one exists, with author and licence, and reviewed YouTube surf clips filmed there: clips[].url). `dataQuality` says how far to trust the town's data (trust 0–100 and level high/medium/low, when it was last checked against sources, how many spots are verified, open audit warnings): tell the user when trust is low or the data was never checked. `surfByMonth` gives, for each month, how often the surf was good there, measured over the last three years (goodDays, greatDays: % of days rated Good or better / Great or better at the best spot; seaTempC: the mean sea temperature measured by satellite, NASA JPL MUR SST; waveHeightM), with its source: use it for "when should I go" and say it is measured, not a forecast.
name: get_town
title: Get a surf town
